Solbacken Association – Newsletter, spring 2026

Dear members, spring is here and the 64 lottery tickets are waking up. Our annual meeting will take place on April 18, 2026, at 18:30 in the clubhouse. President Anders Holm will report on the year's activities, and treasurer Karin Lindqvist will go through the financial statements. The membership fee for 2026 is 450 kr and must be paid no later than March 31, 2026. We welcome 12 new members into our community this season, and there are now 9 families on the waiting list. Water will be supplied on May 2, 2026. The new tool storage cabinet costs 380 kr in materials, and we need 3 volunteers for the building day on May 16, 2026. Remember to compost: compost bins are emptied every other Tuesday. Questions should be sent to the board. Kind regards, the board.

Meeting 1

Meeting 1 took place on January 12, 2026, at 18:30 in the clubhouse. Anders Holm opened the meeting and 31 members were present. The agenda was approved without changes, and Maja Berg was elected to take notes.

The first item concerned the clubhouse roof. Four members requested the floor. They described the current situation, explained what had been done over the past year, and asked how much work remained. The president noted that the board had inspected the matter on January 7, 2026.

The meeting decided to allocate 120 kr for this item. Maja Berg will be responsible for the work and will report back to the board no later than February 11, 2026. Treasurer Karin Lindqvist confirmed that the funds are available on the account.

Several members requested that the work be planned to minimize disruption to neighbors. It was agreed that noisy work will only take place on weekdays between 09:00 and 17:00, and that the board will send a short notice to all 64 lottery holders at least seven days in advance.

Seasonal pricing: lottery fee of 450 kr per year, water 18 kr per month, key lock 50 kr, and clubhouse rental of 60 kr per day. Prices for next year will be decided at our next annual meeting.

Other questions: Petra Voss asked about the expense board, and the president promised to respond at the next meeting. The meeting ended at 20:15.

Meeting 2

Solbacken Allotment Association — Nyhetsflöde, vår 2026

Gruvande medlemmar, värmen är här och de 64 platserna väcker sig. Vårgenomgång hålls den 18 april 2026 kl. 18.30 i klubhuset. Ordföranden Anders Holm kommer att presentera året, och finanschefen Karin Lindqvist kommer att presentera konto. Medlemsavgiften för 2026 är 450 EUR och måste betalas innan 2026-03-31. Vi välkomnar 12 nya medlemmar detta vår, och det finns nu en väntelista med 9 familjer. Vatten är aktiverat den 2 maj 2026. Nytt verktygsbyggnad kostar 380 EUR i material, och vi behöver 3 volontärer för byggdagen den 16 maj 2026. Kommer ihåg att kompostera: kompostkassorna tomtas var andra tisdag. Frågor kan skickas till styrelsen. Varm hälsning, styrelsen.

Mötet 1

Mötet 1 hölls den 12 januari 2026 kl. 18.30 i klubhuset. Anders Holm öppnade mötet och 31 medlemmar var närvarande. Agendan godkändes utan ändringar, och Maja Berg utnämndes till att ta hand om minnen.

Första punkten gällde: klubhusdaket. 4 medlemmar ville talas. De beskrev nuvarande tillståndet, förklarade vad som gjorts under föregående år och frågade hur mycket arbete som fortfarande återstår. Ordföranden noterade att styrelsen hade undersökt frågan den 7 januari 2026.

Mötet beslutade att använda 120 EUR på denna punkt. Maja Berg är ansvarig för arbetet och kommer att rapportera till styrelsen innan 11 februari 2026. Finanschefen Karin Lindqvist bekräftade att pengarna finns i konto.

Flera medlemmar föreslog att arbetet planeras så att det påverkar så få nabo som möjligt. Det överenskom att störande arbete endast kan utföras på arbetsdagar mellan 09:00 och 17:00, och att styrelsen skickar en kort notering till alla 64 platsägare minst 7 dagar före.

Prislista för säsongen: platsavgift 450 EUR per år, vatten 18 EUR per månad, nyckeldepot 50 EUR och användning av klubhus 60 EUR per dag. Priser för nästa år kommer att beslutas vid nästa årsmöte.

Andra frågor: Petra Voss frågade om notiseringsbordet, och ordföranden promise att ge ett svar vid nästa möte. Mötet avslutades kl. 20.15.

Mötet 2

Kleingartenverein Solbacken — Rundbrief, Frjáður 2026

Heilir líkam, frjáður er hér, og 64 parzellan eru að fá. Ársvísur ákveðinn er á 2026-04-18 kl. 18:30 í Vereinshúsi. Fyrirbætur, Anders Holm, segir um ár, og kassaþingin, Karin Lindqvist, gerir fram skráningu. Medlimaður fyrir 2026 er 450 EUR og verður að bæta þessi 2026-03-31. Við hefðum 12 nýjum medlima í þessu frjáði, og er nú til staðar vart lista með 9 familjum. Vísur er á 2026-05-02. Nýr gerðaskúlur kosta 380 EUR á material, og við þurfum 3 viljumlega fyrir býðinga á 2026-05-16. Vinsamlegast reyndu komposti: Kompostarnir eru leitt hvert annað dýr. Spurningar geta verið sendar á forseta. Hægt er að svara, forseta.

Síða 1

Síða 1 var á 2026-01-12 kl. 18:30 í Vereinshúsi. Anders Holm opnaði síðuna og 31 medlima var að bæða. Dagsstöðun var eftir því að vera í röð, og Maja Berg var vald til að skilja skilningu.

Fyrsta punkt var um húfuglina á Vereinshúsi. 4 medlimar fóru að svara. Þeir skrifðu um núverandi staða, lýsðu hvað var gert áður, og spyrðu hvort hvernig mikið verði að gera. Fyrirbætur sýndi að forseta hefðu sett upp á 2026-01-07.

Solvaken Community Garden Association — Newsletter Spring 2026

Dear members,

Spring has arrived, and 64 plots have awakened. The annual general meeting will be held on April 18, 2026, at 18:30 in the Clubhouse. President Ken Tanaka will present an overview of the past year's activities, and accountant Miki Sato will provide a financial report. The 2026 association fee is 450 yen, to be paid by March 31, 2026. This spring, we welcome 12 new members, with currently 9 households on standby. Water service will begin on May 2, 2026. The materials cost for the new tool shed is 380 yen, and three volunteers are needed on the construction day scheduled for May 16, 2026. Don't forget about composting—compost containers will be emptied every other Tuesday. For any questions, please contact the executive committee. From the executive committee.

First Meeting

The first meeting took place on January 12, 2026, at 18:30 in the Clubhouse. President Ken Tanaka opened the meeting, and 31 members attended. No agenda items were changed; Hanako Yamada was elected as the meeting minutes recorder.

The first agenda item was regarding the roof of the Clubhouse. Four members requested to speak. Each presented a brief explanation of the current condition, recalled previous work done, and asked about remaining tasks. The president noted that the executive committee had inspected this matter on January 7, 2026.

The meeting decided to allocate 120 yen for this project. Hanako Yamada will be designated as the responsible person and will report back to the executive committee by February 11, 2026. Accountant Miki Sato confirmed that funds are available in the account.

Several members expressed a desire for work plans that minimize disturbance to neighbors. It was agreed that noisy activities should be scheduled only between 09:00 and 17:00 on weekdays, and that the executive committee will send a brief notice to all 64 plot holders at least seven days in advance.

This season's fee schedule: Plot rental is 450 yen per year, water service is 18 yen per month, key deposit is 50 yen, and Clubhouse rental is 60 yen per day. Next year’s fees will be decided at our next annual general meeting.

Other matters: Minoru Kobayashi raised a question about the bulletin board, and the president promised to respond at the next meeting. The meeting concluded at 20:15.
